objective: Machine-evaluate, at pinned sha256, the three guards of transfer rule T1 in research_map/formulation_taxonomy.yaml (from AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN to AF-SCC-C2-VAC-GEN) against the frozen canonical schemas schemas/af_scc_c0_vacuum.yaml (source, F2b) and schemas/af_scc_c2_vacuum.yaml (target, F2a), and return a guard-level licensing decision for T1. This directly addresses the G-FORM unmet item 'no single frozen data class (s,delta,norm) is shared by F1/F2a/F2b, which disables the licensed C0=>C2 transfer' by decomposing it into G1 (data_class exact match), G2 (genericity_kind/genericity_topology exact match) and G3 (source claim carries artifact_refs and a reviewer verdict). Measurement only: no gate verdict, no node status, no validation_status=passed.

t1_rule_verbatim.reason: If no C0 extension exists, then no C2 extension exists.
guards: data_class fields must match exactly (including s, delta once F2 fixes them)
genericity_kind and genericity_topology must match exactly
the source claim must carry artifact_refs and a reviewer verdict

evaluation_rules_fixed_before_run.G1_literal_reading: PASS iff every leaf path under the F2b data_class subtree equals the same path under the F2a data_class subtree by exact value equality (scalar values compared as parsed, whitespace not collapsed, no normalization, no dropping of parenthetical or post-semicolon text). Witnesses are (path, F2a value, F2b value, F2a line, F2b line). The two schemas are the only files compared for G1; F1 (AF-WCC-VAC-GEN) is out of scope for T1.
evaluation_rules_fixed_before_run.G1_secondary_reading: T3-normalized core reading, identical to FORM-DC-ALIGN-071 T3: drop parenthesized fragments and text after the first ';', collapse whitespace, strip trailing punctuation. Reported as a convenience reading and never as the binding G1 verdict.
evaluation_rules_fixed_before_run.G2_literal_reading: Resolve the exact literal field names 'genericity_kind' and 'genericity_topology' as dotted key paths in each schema. PASS iff both names resolve in both schemas and their values are equal in both directions; UNEVALUABLE_AS_WRITTEN if either name does not resolve in either schema (a missing field cannot be a match); FAIL iff both resolve and are unequal.
evaluation_rules_fixed_before_run.G2_secondary_reading: Mapped reading using genericity.kind and genericity.topology_or_measure (the actual field names in the frozen schemas). The mapping is inferred by this artifact and is NOT declared in F0; reported separately so a gate owner can decide whether the mapping is legitimate.
evaluation_rules_fixed_before_run.G3_literal_reading: The source claim = a claim in the pinned research_map.json whose class_id or class_ids includes AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN. PASS iff at least one such claim has non-empty artifact_refs AND at least one review in the pinned map targets that claim (target_id equal to the claim event_id) with a verdict in {accept, revise, reject, inconclusive}. FAIL otherwise. Population sizes are reported, including the count of C0 claims whose conclusion text actually asserts C0 future-inextendibility.
evaluation_rules_fixed_before_run.overall_decision: T1_licensed_at_pins = (G1 PASS) AND (G2 PASS) AND (G3 PASS) under the literal readings. UNEVALUABLE_AS_WRITTEN at any guard counts as NOT PASS and is reported as a distinct blocked state. Secondary readings never change the binding decision.

controls_fixed_before_run.CTL_POS_G1: A synthetic copy of F2a data_class compared against F2b data_class with the F2a copy replaced by F2b's own data_class must evaluate PASS.
controls_fixed_before_run.CTL_NEG_G1: Two synthetic copies of F2a data_class differing only at asymptotic_decay.parity_conditions must evaluate FAIL with exactly that witness path.
controls_fixed_before_run.CTL_POS_G2: Two synthetic documents carrying genericity_kind and genericity_topology with equal values must evaluate PASS under the literal G2 rule.
controls_fixed_before_run.CTL_NEG_G2: Two synthetic documents carrying genericity_kind and genericity_topology with one unequal value must evaluate FAIL under the literal G2 rule.
controls_fixed_before_run.CTL_POS_G3: A synthetic claim with non-empty artifact_refs plus a synthetic review targeting it must evaluate PASS under the G3 rule.
controls_fixed_before_run.CTL_NEG_G3: A synthetic claim with non-empty artifact_refs and no review must evaluate FAIL under the G3 rule.
controls_fixed_before_run.self_equality: F2a data_class compared against itself must evaluate PASS under G1 strict.
controls_fixed_before_run.hash_stability: All four inputs are hashed before and after the evaluation; any change sets window_status=VOID at the changed path and voids the result (exit code 2).

falsifier: Re-run artifacts/worker-071/t1_guard_eval/eval_t1_guards.py at the same four pinned sha256 values. This report is falsified per guard if G1_literal evaluates PASS, or G2_literal evaluates PASS, or G3_literal evaluates PASS, contrary to the recorded per-guard verdicts; if all three evaluate PASS then T1 is licensed at the pins, the G-FORM unmet item is refuted at the whole strength of the transfer rule, and this report's overall verdict is falsified. Any input sha256 change across the pre/post window voids the result at the changed path and requires a re-run; the window check is part of the instrument (exit code 2 on drift).
limitations: G1 compares F2b (source) with F2a (target) only; F1 (AF-WCC-VAC-GEN) is a different transfer family and is not part of T1.
The G2 mapped reading uses a mapping (genericity_kind -> genericity.kind, genericity_topology -> genericity.topology_or_measure) inferred by this artifact; F0 does not declare it.
G3 binds claims recorded in research_map/research_map.json only; un-ingested outbox traffic is out of scope by construction.
Line numbers are value-node start lines from the YAML composer.
No gate verdict, no node status, no validation_status=passed is asserted.
authority_note: Worker output only. Canonical paths are authoritative per research_map/ASTRA_HANDOFF.md and research_map/research_map.json publication_status.policy. The lead-formulation owns the schema; the controller and group leads own verdicts.
